Maya: rough check-in: proposing a tiny warmup state machine + tiny adapter surface to unify safetensors/mmap/gzip bundles. aim is predictable activation semantics across hosted/dedicated/private.

Liam: worker-owned state machine or central coordinator?

Maya: worker-owned preferred. coordinator only hands priority and credits.

Devin: state enum?

Maya: draft: INIT -> RESOLVE -> HEADER_SCAN -> INDEX_TRY -> CHUNK_PREFETCH -> KVCACHE_APPLY -> VERIFY -> ACTIVE -> ERROR/RETRY. adapters provide flags (supports_index, zero_copy, prefix_safe).

Sara: for prefix activation we need an "activation window" (max_unverified_tokens) and gating so long sequences are limited until VERIFY. hosted default small window, enterprise strict.

Liam: eviction semantics?

Maya: warmup run gets liveness token and resume_token (last_applied_chunk). eviction cancels token -> adapter returns Cancelled -> state machine either retry from resume_token or rollback to last stable. retries bounded and resume_token TTL enforced.

Devin: adapter surface minimal: probe(meta)->caps, open(range)->stream, verify_stream(async)->result, finalize(). adapters should mark per-file critical=true/false for bundles.

Sara: telemetry: emit activation_type (soft/hard), percent_verified, verify_ms, prefetch_bytes, retries, eviction_cancel_count. console should show model-state and resume_token_age.

Liam: mixed-format bundles: orchestrate per-file subruns, ACTIVE only when critical parts verified.

Maya: kvcache change: accept_prefix(layer, offset, blob, resume_token) and mark entries verified=false until verify completes. runtime gates long-context attention if entries unverified.

Devin: security: adapter exposes requires_decrypt and kms_key_id; verify_stream accepts decrypted bytes.

infra-bot: canary: warmup-unify-2026 pushed to staging.

Sara: I'll prototype safetensors adapter + tests: index fastpath, streaming prefix activation, mmap zero-copy, eviction+resume, mixed bundle, kms handshake.

Maya: I'll write short RFC + diagram later today. post comments there. :rocket:
